title: 16-Layer Continuous Optimization with Fine Step Tolerance
scientific_hypothesis: Increasing layer count from 14 to 16 while disabling integer-rounding and using ≤0.05 nm step-tolerance will escape the integer-attractor basin that caused score regression in Rounds 2-4, allowing gradient-based optimization to discover superior continuous thickness configurations for dual-band filtering.
design_principle: Quarter-wave optical thickness initialization at 550 nm center of visible stopband, with HfO2 (high-index) and SiO2 (low-index) alternating layers. Outer layer is SiO2 for environmental durability. All thicknesses treated as continuous variables without post-processing rounding.
proposed_topology: Air | (HfO2 | SiO2)_8 | Fused Silica - exactly 16 finite layers
design_variables: Layer thicknesses (16 continuous variables, no integer rounding)
manufacturing_considerations: Continuous thickness values require high-precision deposition control
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflection band design
Continuous optimization avoids local minima from discretization
expected_advantages: More degrees of freedom than 14-layer designs
known_risks: May still converge to suboptimal local minimum if initialization is poor
16 layers approach upper complexity limit for some fabrication processes
execution_request_english: Optimize a 16-layer HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate for dual-band filtering. Incident medium: Air. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 (16 finite layers, starting with HfO2, ending with SiO2). Initialize thicknesses using quarter-wave optical thickness at 550 nm center wavelength. Optimize all 16 thicknesses as continuous variables with step-tolerance ≤0.05 nm. Disable integer-rounding post-processing. Initialize candidate pool from Round 3 decimal thickness values (113.5-158.0 nm range) perturbed by ±1.5 nm Gaussian noise. Wavelength bands: maximize transmittance at 1530-1565 nm, maximize reflectance at 400-700 nm. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with learning rate 0.025. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers.
revision_reason: Increased layer count from 14 to 16 to escape excluded fingerprints and provide additional degrees of freedom. Disabled integer-rounding and set fine step-tolerance per feedback directive to escape integer-attractor basin causing score regression.
